highlights.text: An annotation is extra information associated with a particular point in
Annotations are sometimes presented in the margin of book pages.
For annotations of different digital media, see web annotation

Annotation Practices are highlighting a phrase or sentence and including a comment, circling a word that needs defining, posing a question when something is not fully understood and writing a short summary of a key section.
